{{Top|leg}}
'''Abrax''' was an aquamarine [[Cognac/Legends|cognac]], an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage, with a spicy vapor. [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] enjoyed it and had two bottles of a vintage Abrax dating to the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
